forecast: One row per instrument at the close. It contains 1-, 5- and 21-session returns, 21-session volatility, the day’s price range, unusual volume, the fall from a 63-session high, and that day’s S&P 500 fund return.
Each gives probabilities of a rise, little change and a fall. Logistic regression uses a linear model. XGBoost and LightGBM build trees.

The same eight market features in order over the latest 20 sessions. Long short-term memory and gated recurrent unit models learn from the sequence. A temporal convolutional network looks for local patterns. The Patch Transformer uses four blocks of five sessions.
Each gives the same three direction probabilities.
13 market-wide investment-theme returns compounded over 21 sessions and delayed by another 21 sessions.
A logistic model gives direction probabilities for each instrument.
Fed statement tone and age, headline tone and availability, and annual filing tone and availability.
FinBERT produces text sentiment scores. A logistic model turns the eligible scores into the three direction probabilities.
The latest eligible Federal Reserve statement. Each model scores that statement separately.
Three market-direction probabilities per model. Each forecast is shared across instruments.
Two recent returns, recent volatility, headline and filing scores and availability for each anonymized instrument, plus the prior Fed statement.
Three direction probabilities per instrument. The last eligible monthly forecast carries forward to the next refresh.
controller: Market-state model
Daily log returns and 21-session volatility of the S&P 500 fund.
Three probabilities for lower-, middle- and higher-return market states. These are inputs to the vote counter.
Original learned gate, with or without market states
Calibrated expert forecasts plus volatility, range, drawdown, market movement, text scores and earlier expert accuracy. The full version also reads the market-state probabilities.
Estimates which experts are likely to be correct, normalizes the estimates into voting shares, and blends the three probabilities.
Equal votes, fixed mixture and context adapter
The same expert forecasts within each tested group. The context adapter also reads observed market and text features.
Equal votes are uniform. The fixed mixture learns constant shares. The adapter changes the shares by instrument and date. Both learned mixtures minimize forecast log loss.
Adaptive router used in stress tests
The same 13 forecasts, market-state probabilities, earlier fitted weights and recent forecast losses whose outcomes have arrived.
A blend that gives more weight to forecasts that did better in similar conditions.
Reinforcement-learning model router
A pool of archived forecasts, observed context and recent resolved forecast losses. Switching from the previous model carries a small penalty.
Picks one forecaster per instrument and date. That model’s full probability forecast goes to the fixed trading rule.
Classic mixture and jointly trained mixture

The classic mixture’s three models share market features, factor returns and text scores. The joint experiment uses an eight-session sequence of price and volume features, daily Fed and company text scores, and broad-market returns, volatility and the share of instruments rising.
Three internal forecasts, three learned voting shares and one combined forecast. The joint experiment also averages the same forecasts as a control.
Fixed trading rule and learned portfolio allocator
The fixed rule ranks the combined up-minus-down scores and uses volatility for sizing. The allocator also receives the prior allocation, summary scores and broad-market returns and volatility.
The rule gives target weights for up to five instruments. The allocator chooses cash, the S&P 500 fund or the classic mixture’s basket. The simulator records next-open trades, costs and balances.
OpenAI research agent
Earlier model results and a bounded list of possible settings for the vote counter.
Proposes one setting for validation before a later annual test. In the archived five-session study the incumbent setting stayed in use.
